Canvas Commands and History
|-- [M] Modular structure: editing, history, composition, and transfer boundaries
|   |-- Editing facade: MappingDocumentController
|   |   |-- Exposes applyUpdate/transact, commitEditorGesture, snapshots, subscriptions,
|   |   |   undo/redo, saved views, revision exports, and transfer preparation
|   |   |-- Shared by mounted editing and headless proposals
|   |   |-- Keeps operation staging, snapshot replacement, node correspondence,
|   |   |   display caching, and optional editor driver private
|   |   `-- Depends on history service, revision operations, layout, and anchor validation
|   |-- History boundary: CanvasHistoryService
|   |   |-- Exposes context-based append, navigate, resolve, fork, adopt, and persistence
|   |   |-- Default implementation delegates to CanvasHistory
|   |   |   `-- Private context lookup hides the history instances from callers
|   |   `-- CanvasHistory uses issued revisions, checkpoint encoding, and view validation
|   |-- Composition and connection rules
|   |   |-- LineGrid exposes measurement, immutable box edits, layout, composition,
|   |   |   flattening, collision queries, and hit testing
|   |   |-- Reusable contents are separate from the hierarchical GridBox placements
|   |   `-- Connection validation/reconciliation depends on placements and content nodes
|   `-- Cross-canvas transfer
|       |-- Exposes preparation, boundary checks, and coordinated navigation preparation
|       |-- Depends on isolated histories, revision creation, placement, and link rebasing
|       `-- Returns prepared states; workspace transaction owns publication
|-- [C] Calls: command execution and checkpoint navigation
|   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations); transact delegates here
|   |   |-- Settle pending live gesture; clear temporary node correspondence
|   |   `-- applyOperations
|   |       |-- Require current version and a valid operation count
|   |       |   `-- Conflict -> reject with VERSION_CONFLICT
|   |       |-- Clone current document/view; execute operations in array order
|   |       |   |-- Later operations see earlier staged changes
|   |       |   |-- Content edits -> revision operations -> layout/reconcile as needed
|   |       |   |-- Placement edits -> move, duplicate, group, collapse, or remove
|   |       |   `-- Connections, presentation, selections, reviews, and context updates
|   |       |       `-- Check operation-specific IDs, revisions, hashes, and anchors
|   |       |-- Finish batch cleanup and scene projection before checkpoint publication
|   |       `-- updateSnapshot(record=true)
|   |           |-- Synchronize selection; reconcile links; validate connections
|   |           |-- Normalize diagram views and resolve floating geometry
|   |           |-- historyService.append -> CanvasHistory.append
|   |           |   |-- Validate document and referenced revisions
|   |           |   |-- Build bindings, logical anchors, node origins, and saved view
|   |           |   `-- Publish checkpoint; push old head to past; clear future
|   |           `-- Replace controller snapshot, advance version, notify subscribers
|   |               `-- applyUpdate returns nodes/version; finally clears correspondence
|   |-- commitEditorGesture(operations, canvas)
|   |   |-- Operations -> same applyOperations path with the supplied editor view
|   |   |-- Grid moves settle together after the operation loop
|   |   `-- Gesture and its selection/layout consequences become one checkpoint
|   |-- undo(redo)
|   |   |-- Live editor attached -> editorDriver.undo(redo)
|   |   |   `-- restoreEditorCheckpoint navigates to an archived checkpoint
|   |   |-- Headless -> historyService.navigate -> CanvasHistory.navigate
|   |   |   `-- Validate target; move head between past/future; restore document/view
|   |   `-- Transfer-linked checkpoint -> service rejects local navigation
|   |       `-- Workspace must coordinate both participating canvases
|   `-- prepareTransfer -> prepareCanvasTransfer
|       |-- Validate distinct canvases and unique selected diagram placements
|       |-- Build isolated source/destination histories and remap transferred identities
|       |-- Copy
|       |   |-- Create fresh placement/content IDs; leave source history unchanged
|       |   `-- Copy edges only when both endpoints are selected
|       |-- Move
|       |   |-- Preserve IDs where destination has no collision
|       |   |-- Remove selected source placements; retain still-used source contents
|       |   `-- Convert source edges to jumps, assigned by their source placement
|       |-- Append destination; append source for move; attach transaction links
|       `-- prepareTransferNavigation
|           |-- Both heads must match recorded before/after boundaries
|           |-- Newer edits or invalid transaction state -> reject
|           `-- Navigate destination, plus source for move; return prepared states
|-- [O] Ownership: runtime state, retained revisions, and branch lifetimes
|   |-- Controller owns its runtime snapshot, listeners, cache, and gesture bookkeeping
|   |   |-- At most one attached editor driver; returned callback detaches that driver
|   |   `-- Transient selection/layout updates can avoid checkpoint/version advancement
|   |-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService owns histories through a WeakMap
|   |   |-- Frozen object handle identifies each editing context
|   |   |-- Two viewers can have separate handles despite the same persisted context ID
|   |   `-- Unreferenced handles allow their history association to be garbage-collected
|   |-- CanvasHistory owns checkpoint archive, revision table, and navigation state
|   |   |-- Checkpoint stores composition + diagram bindings + personal view
|   |   |   `-- Composition does not embed diagram contents
|   |   |-- Bindings retain exact issued revisions, plus required revision dependencies
|   |   |-- Append after undo clears redo navigation but retains archived checkpoints
|   |   |-- fork creates a new context/baseline with empty past/future
|   |   |-- adopt publishes a proposed state as one checkpoint with exact revision IDs
|   |   `-- persistenceChanges exposes navigation/header and changed storage records
|   |-- Saved CanvasViews belong to the history, outside undo-restored composition
|   |   |-- create/save pin checkpoints; saved endpoints retain their prior snapshots
|   |   |-- open stashes the active working copy and resumes the target working copy
|   |   |   `-- Creates a navigation checkpoint while retaining the current camera
|   |   |-- fork opens a child from the parent's saved endpoint
|   |   |-- alternatives creates sibling children from one pinned saved checkpoint
|   |   |   `-- Does not switch the active canvas
|   |   |-- keep saves one candidate and archives siblings and their descendants
|   |   |-- discard archives a view and descendants; delete requires a leaf
|   |   |-- Generation retains candidate endpoints without switching the live head
|   |   `-- Saved/recording views force full history retention during current-only export
|   `-- Placement identity and content identity have different lifetimes
|       |-- duplicate-instance adds a placement referencing the same contentId
|       |-- Editing that content changes what every referencing placement resolves
|       |-- delete-diagrams prunes contents only when remaining placements no longer use them
|       `-- Historical bindings continue to retain earlier revisions
`-- [D] Data dependency: what computed results require, across the boundaries above
    |-- Resolved document = checkpoint composition + bound revision payloads
    |   |-- snapshotId -> StoredCanvasSnapshot
    |   |-- diagramBindings[contentId] -> revisionId -> revision.diagram [shared R]
    |   |-- Placement root + contents assembled from [shared R] -> LineGridScene
    |   `-- Canonical edges + revision nodeRefs -> revision-specific read-model anchors
    |       `-- Already-unresolved anchors retain their original stale endpoint data
    |-- Valid connection endpoint
    |   |-- displayNodeId -> existing GridBox
    |   |-- Content endpoint -> diagram content revision + contentNodeId membership
    |   |   `-- Reads content nodes from the bound content [shared R]
    |   `-- Reconciliation needs before/after scenes and evidence of correspondence
    |       |-- Deleted placement -> remove incident edge
    |       |-- Proven node mapping -> rebase endpoint
    |       |-- Unchanged ASCII/structure -> position-based correspondence is permitted
    |       `-- Otherwise preserve stale anchor; do not guess a new target
    |-- Resolved bounds and composed ASCII
    |   |-- Placement positions + ancestor offsets -> absolute origins
    |   |-- Content ASCII [shared R] -> measured rows/columns
    |   |-- Expanded children + minimum size -> expanded bounds
    |   |-- Collapsed content -> collapsed bounds; expanded reservation is ignored
    |   `-- Layout needs bounds + sibling gap + changed subtree
    |       |-- Anchor changed subtree; settle other siblings in stable spatial order
    |       |-- Collisions move unsettled siblings only to the right
    |       `-- Composition checks final collisions and supported extents/cell count
    `-- Saved-view comparison
        |-- startCheckpointId -> baseline document/view + exact revision dependencies
        |-- finalCheckpointId -> proposed document/view + exact revision dependencies
        `-- Materialize those two endpoints without navigating through the undo archive
